one_liner: A policy gate that intercepts proposed transfers and blocks any write that breaches thresholds — live chain checks, one plain policy file, mainnet refused outright.
what_it_does: Before any transfer goes out, this guardian checks it against a written policy and can stop it cold. A too-large transfer is held, a mainnet attempt is refused outright — the blocked ones broadcast nothing and spend nothing. Proven by 1 real on-chain transaction (the allowed dust transfer), plus 3 blocked and refused proposals that spent nothing, all linked below.
